title: The Beginning
description: Livora started with a simple vision: make modern people management easier for growing teams. We began by researching the everyday challenges businesses face in managing employees, operations, and workplace communication.

title: First Product
description: We launched the first version of Livora, bringing essential HR tools into one connected experience. Our focus was on creating a simple, intuitive platform that helps teams spend less time managing processes and more time supporting their people.

title: Growing Together
description: Livora evolved with new tools for employee management, onboarding, collaboration, and workplace operations. Feedback from growing teams helped us improve the platform and build a more flexible experience for modern businesses.

title: Looking Ahead
description: We continue to build new experiences that make people management simpler, smarter, and more connected for organizations everywhere.
